references.text: Asher is mentioned as a son of Jacob and Zilpah, the ancestor of the tribe of Asher counted here.
Asher is listed among Jacob's twelve sons born in Paddan-Aram, and his descendants make up the tribe that is counted.
The sons of Asher are mentioned when Jacob's family went to Egypt, showing the origin of the tribe.
Gives the total number of men from the tribe of Asher who were counted: 41,500.
The tribe of Asher receives its place in the camp near the Tabernacle as part of Dan's group.
The second counting of the tribe of Asher on the plains of Moab, showing the tribe's growth over 40 years.
Moses blesses the tribe of Asher before his death and promises them prosperity.
The tribe of Asher is given its territory in Canaan after the conquest.
